### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: When reporting patient medications, distinguish between possession/prescription and current active use. List all mentioned medications, even if not actively used, and specify their status (e.g., "has albuterol inhaler PRN, not used recently"). Do not infer absence of medication if one is mentioned.
[P]: Ensure all medication instructions, especially indications, are precisely copied from the doctor's statements. Do not broaden the scope of use beyond what is explicitly stated (e.g., "for fever or pain" vs. "if symptoms develop").
